prefill.name: exact selected client.name plus Tour
prefill.area: client.city and client.state; never a claimed search preference
prefill.notes: short client.notes summary; original entry expands in the draft popup
prefill.saved_search_draft: same-tab search area and use for the exact selected client or Research; Plan from search retains that subject and existing plan edits; these are user-entered app drafts, not a canonical CARR search brief
prefill.packet_search_criteria: all nonempty SEARCH_FIELDS from the exact Plan subject at review time, rendered separately from itinerary facts; current search edits appear on reopening, without a canonical revision or route handoff
prefill.record_refresh_review: A brand-new draft prefills once. A refresh never writes into an existing draft; every client-sourced field that differs from the draft, including typed and empty values, offers a keep-or-use choice. Nonidentity comparisons show before/after values and the local successful read time. This is a client-record read, not a mail/calendar capture receipt or evidence date.

storage.drafts: sessionStorage scoped to the hash of the authenticated Tour session token; Research and exact client IDs retain independent plan and search drafts, including deliberately cleared fields
storage.files: memory only; no file bytes, names or derived contents are persisted or transmitted

unavailable_operations: private workspace file upload and authorized agent packet compilation
licensed MLS query and listing matches
safety: Unsupported actions stay disabled; catalog search is not MLS search.
No default date, budget, appointment, listing result or navigation coordinate is invented.
Selecting another client clears prior-client values; late responses are discarded.
Background updates refresh the record and tour details without writing into existing drafts.
Files are never included in public projection, share or PDF commands.
Territory shows Census context only; no property or native-navigation pins are presented.
Research packet review does not require a client or a readable client directory.
A failed selected-client detail read retains the exact selection and offers explicit retry without clearing edits or files; client packet review waits for a successful detail read.
Client switches restore only that subject's tab-local draft; a session change clears every subject's cached draft.
Plan from search validates criteria before changing the plan subject and preserves private files when the subject is already selected.
Packet search criteria never use another selected Search subject as a fallback. Cleared criteria remain absent after reload.

A differing client-sourced tour name, including a typed or empty draft value, requires Keep draft name or Use current name before packet review; typing a tour name is also explicit selection. Both choices affect only the app draft and never write client identity.

Client refresh change details and pending name choices stay in memory, clear on subject/session change, and render record values as inert text. Unresolved name differences are detected again after reload.
